# {{ app_domain }}

> Shellui Hosting. Deploy Shellui apps to stable HTTPS subdomains on *.{{ app_domain }}.

## What this is
{% if hosting_region %}Region: {{ hosting_region }}. Sites and their data stay in this region.
{% endif %}{{ app_domain }} is the hosting surface for the Shellui platform. Build with the Shellui CLI, log in, deploy, and get a public URL such as {{ example_app_url }}. Products run inside the shell; this host handles public URLs, previews, and delivery.

## Quick start
```
shellui login
shellui deploy
```

Example CLI output:
```
Logged in as you@example.com
Uploading build…
Deployed
q8n4m2xk7wph {{ example_app_url }}
```
